description: This bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the ratio (%) of performance or perception for three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three distinct knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis presents the three knowledge categories in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis, labeled "Ratio (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 10. For each category, there are three adjacent bars representing the respective model's ratio. In the "Movies" category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 90%, the Qwen2 bar is also at approximately 90%, and the ChatGPT bar is at approximately 72%. In the "Songs" category, the Llama3 bar is at approximately 84%, the Qwen2 bar is at approximately 90%, and the ChatGPT bar is at approximately 62%. In the "Basketball" category, the Llama3 bar is at approximately 67%, the Qwen2 bar is at approximately 58%, and the ChatGPT bar is at approximately 61%. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the categories listed on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their standard presentation.
